mapper.select: SELECT CAST(pm.member_id AS CHAR) AS id, pm.name AS name, CASE WHEN pm.status = 1 THEN 'online' ELSE 'offline' END AS status, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_main om WHERE om.camp_id = pm.camp_id AND om.is_deleted = 0 AND om.source_type = 'wechat_service' ) AS todaySessions, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_main om WHERE om.camp_id = pm.camp_id AND om.is_deleted = 0 AND om.source_type = 'wechat_service' ) THEN 96 ELSE 0 END AS averageReplySeconds, CASE WHEN pm.status = 1 THEN 98 ELSE 0 END AS serviceScore FROM pms_member pm WHERE pm.camp_id = #{campId} AND pm.is_deleted = 0 AND pm.wecom_user_id IS NOT NULL AND pm.wecom_user_id != '' ORDER BY pm.updated_at DESC, pm.member_id ASC
SELECT CAST(poi_id AS CHAR) AS id, poi_name AS label FROM pms_poi WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_no ASC, poi_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN channel_name LIKE '%美团%' THEN 'meituan' WHEN channel_name LIKE '%携程%' THEN 'ctrip' WHEN channel_name LIKE '%小猪%' THEN 'xiaozhu' WHEN channel_name LIKE '%途家%' OR channel_name LIKE '%去哪%' THEN 'tujia' ELSE LOWER(CAST(channel_id AS CHAR)) END AS id, channel_name AS label FROM channel_account WHERE camp_id = #{campId} ORDER BY label ASC
SELECT CAST(im_phrase_id AS CHAR) AS id, title, content FROM im_phrase WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_no ASC, im_phrase_id ASC LIMIT 8
